_source: FUN_0002af28 (preparation/selection screen) -> FUN_0002b439 validator, read from the branch chain at 0x2b2c2..0x2b34d in the current EXE, 2026-09-07

_validator.logic: scans roster records 1..count for record[+8] == required_char_id; if absent it sets DAT_00053ad9 = required_char_id + 1 (the name index for the message) and shows 「本章○○必須出場！」, returning 0
_validator.observed_consequence: failing it clears the entire selection (live: 剩餘人數 back to the cap, all cells grey)

_after_validation: the same chapter->id chain is repeated at 0x2b358..0x2b3af but calling FUN_0002b843(id) instead -- i.e. once validated, the mandatory character is put through that function before the final confirmation dialog (FDTXT 0x4b via 0x1956b)

_deployment_cap.meaning: cap is 15 for raw chapter <= 0x1a, 19 above it
_deployment_cap.live_confirmed: raw chapter 0x16 showed 出戰人數 ×15

_grid: the selection cursor runs over DAT_00053bfb - 1 entries (roster_count minus the fixed record 0), 10 per row (up/down move by 10); live-confirmed as 17 cells for an 18-member roster and 18 for 19
_chapter_numbering: displayed chapter = raw chapter + 1 (raw 0x1a = 第二十七章, per the load menu)
